title: The Rijksmuseum shares copyright-free images
content: The Colosseum in Rome by Josephus Augustus Knip, 1809, watercolor, 425mm × w 597mmAmsterdam'sRijksmuseum Museumhas made its collection available as digital images for free online. You can download high-resolution files and use them however you want. All you have to do is set up an account with your email and a password.Famous for its Rembrandts, the museum has about two thousand works from the Dutch Golden Age, including by Frans Hals, Jacob van Ruisdael, Johannes Vermeer, Jan Steen, and the students of Rembrandt.----Rijksmuseum StudioBlog post by Ian VisitsThanks, Joseph Santoyo
